ko_summary: @StockSavvyShay는 $META 5년물 CDS 사상 최고치를 과도하게 해석하고 있다고 본다. Meta는 여전히 AA 등급에 현금 약 820억 달러, 연 약 2,500억 달러 광고 사업을 갖고 있어, 급등은 부도 위험보다 은행들의 AI 부채 조달 익스포저 헤지일 수 있다고 했다. 캡처에는 META 654.38달러, 당일 43.14달러(6.18%) 하락이 보인다.
text:
Seeing a lot of fear around $META 5-year credit default swaps hitting an all-time high but I think people are reading way too much into this.

Meta is still AA-rated with ~$82B in cash and a massive ads business generating ~$250B annually giving it a much stronger credit profile so the recent spike could have more to do with banks hedging exposure to Meta's massive AI debt financing than actual default risk.

Really important not to confuse rising CDS spreads as some type of signal for a weakening business because thats not whats happening here.

Upside in retention or paid user % commentary. $SPCX said Grokbot has 800K paid which is high bar. If $META guides up capex that's bullish entire infra stack.
ko_summary: $META 실적에서 기대할 것이 많지 않다고 봄. 장기적으로 강세이나 시장은 AI 컴퓨트를 이익으로 전환하는 것을 중시; Muse 수익화는 여전히 모호하며 Zuck이 세부사항을 제공할 것으로 의심. 유지율 또는 유료 사용자 % 코멘트가 상승 요인. $SPCX가 Grokbot 유료 80만이라고 했는데 높은 기준. $META가 capex를 상향 가이드하면 전체 인프라 스택에 강세.
text: Note: Don't think there is much to look forward to on $META earnings. Long term bullish this name but this market doesn't really care about user growth on Muse which is mostly priced in it cares about turning AI compute into profit. The question of how Muse gets monetized is still pretty vague and I don't expect Zuck to provide much color. Upside would be in any commentary on retention or what % of users are paid though I doubt they provide that. $SPCX said Grokbot has 800K paid which is a very high bar. On AI capex, if $META guides up capex that's bullish the entire infra stack and shows their conviciton in this Muse product to return the spending.

en_summary: @KawzInvests says alt data on $META's Muse app is mixed into earnings: Sensor Tower estimates 10.2 million US downloads through Oct. 17, daily active users up 15% week over week, and 23% of September installers still returning after two weeks, but search interest has cooled and Meta is spending heavily on promotion. He estimates Q3 capex at $40 to $45 billion against the $130 to $145 billion annual guide and sees a possible raise or a result near the high end if usage keeps growing. ko_summary: @KawzInvests는 실적 앞두고 $META Muse 앱의 대체 데이터가 엇갈린다고 했다. 센서타워는 10월 17일까지 미국 다운로드 1,020만 건, 일간 활성 사용자 주간 15% 증가, 9월 설치자의 23%가 2주 뒤에도 재방문한다고 추정했지만 검색 관심은 식었고 메타는 홍보에 많은 돈을 쓰고 있다. 그는 3분기 설비투자를 400억~450억 달러로 보며 연간 1,300억~1,450억 달러 가이던스 대비 사용량이 늘면 상향이나 상단 근접도 가능하다고 했다. 약 100억 달러의 3분기 법률 비용이 보고 이익을 크게 누르고 250억 달러 뉴멕시코 판결이 불확실성을 더한다고 했다. 차트는 Muse와 Grok Bot의 다운로드와 검색 관심을 비교한다.
text:
The alt data on $META’s Muse is mixed heading into earnings.

Sensor Tower estimates 10.2M US downloads through Oct. 17, with daily active users up 15% week over week.

Early retention looks encouraging too. 23% of September installers were still coming back after two weeks. But search interest has cooled, and Meta is spending heavily to promote the app.

Meta’s $130–145B capex guide came before Muse launched. With ~$51B spent in the first half, I’m thinking $40–45B for Q3. If usage keeps growing, I wouldn’t be surprised to see them raise the annual guide or land near the high end.

Meta already expects a ~$10B Q3 legal charge, and today’s $25B New Mexico ruling adds more uncertainty.

The $10B charge alone is going to weigh heavily on reported earnings.
